[EN] I think something watches us from above.
[ES] Creo que algo nos observa desde arriba.

[EN] Quiet! I thought I heard something.
[ES] ¡Silencio! Creí haber oído algo.

[EN] We're a shambles, and we haven't even started fighting.
[ES] Estamos hechos un desastre y ni siquiera hemos empezado a luchar.
